summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute an obfuscated 727KB sibling payload
details: The package declares a preinstall hook `node setup.mjs` that fires automatically on `npm install`. `setup.mjs` (itself obfuscated with javascript-obfuscator's variable-renaming and per-function string maps) downloads the Bun runtime archive from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods the binary to 0o755, and then invokes it via `execFileSync(bunBinary, [join(D, 'math_init.js')])`. The executed sibling file `math_init.js` is a 727KB single-line, heavily obfuscated script (custom-alphabet base64 decoder, rotating string-constant array, `with` blocks, `@bun-cjs` header) that has no reference from the package's declared `main`/`bin` (`dist/main.js`, which is the actual MCP server for React component docs). Executing the obfuscated payload under a freshly-downloaded Bun runtime bypasses Node-based scanners and policies, and the payload's behavior is deliberately hidden from static review. The alternate-runtime install + obfuscated, purpose-mismatched payload is the alternate-runtime-dropper shape.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
